goal: Allow node operators to disallow unencrypted v1 P2P connections on clearnet
Guards node traffic against passive on-path eavesdroppers without disabling clearnet entirely
reviewability: Needs rebase and author response to an open objection before further review
agreement: Broad concept support to guard clearnet traffic from passive observers (mzumsande, dergoegge, sipa)
Unaddressed objection: counterproductive, risks partitions, and misleads users (1440000bytes)
Open disagreement on whether to mandate disabling inbound clearnet connections (gmaxwell, sedited)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it protects node traffic from passive on-path eavesdroppers on IPv4 and IPv6
Prevents accidental plaintext leaks when nodes fall back to legacy v1 connections
